descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Transport feroviar
About Hitachi Rail 
 At Hitachi Rail, we advance signaling and control technologies to make rail transportation safe and efficient. Our technologies help billions of people reach their destinations reliably by rail every year – actively contributing to a strong rail system across the globe.
 Job purpose 
 You will have the opportunity to work with experts from Romania and Germany (Berlin) in a very dynamic and complex environment and also you will be responsible for testing the ETCS Level2 software products like Radio Block Centre.
 Job summary 
 Test of complex and safety-critical application software for the railway field;
 The ideal candidate combines testing experience with strong Linux, networking, scripting and cybersecurity knowledge.
 As Test Engineer you shall be able to:
Understand ERA/UNISIG SUBSET-114, SUBSET-137 and SUBSET-146.
Understand cryptographic concepts and security protocols.
Install and configure systems in the laboratory.
Create and execute automated tests using Ruby and/or Python.
Analyze logs, network traces and test results.
 Professional competencies 
 Education: 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Transportation Engineering or a related field (Engineering background is a must)
 Required technical competencies: 
Requirements-based testing (positive, negative, boundary, failure-handling, robustness).
Linux: services, permissions, shell scripting and log analysis.
Networking, TLS, PKI and X.509 certificates.
Cybersecurity testing.
Intermediate Ruby and/or Python skills.
 Would be a plus: 
CENELEC EN 50128 / EN 50716
CENELEC EN 50126 / EN 50129
Experience in Railway Business / ETCS
